newsitem.title: JAPAN: Eisai shares higher on solid earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Eisai shares higher on solid earnings forecast.

text.p: Shares in Eisai Co Ltd rose on Tuesday morning, helped by its solid earnings forecast, traders said.
The share price of the pharmaceuticals firm jumped 40 yen to 2,100 yen by 0134 GMT, in a turnover of 677,000 shares.
Eisai said it expected parent current profit in the business year to March 31, 1997, to rise to 41.00 billion yen from 40.18 billion yen a year earlier.
Brokers said rises in Eisai shares have lagged behind gains in the pharmaceuticals sector, and that the factor was attracting buying interest.
